import numpy as np
from tslearn.utils import from_seglearn_dataset

# Create a seglearn-formatted dataset (list of 2D arrays with variable lengths)
seglearn_arr = [
    X[0, :10, :],  # shape (10, 1)
    X[1, :5, :]    # shape (5, 1)
]

# Convert to tslearn format
tslearn_arr = from_seglearn_dataset(seglearn_arr)

# Verify the shape is (n_ts, max_sz, d)
assert tslearn_arr.shape == (2, 10, 1), f"Expected shape (2, 10, 1), got {tslearn_arr.shape}"

# Verify that the shorter time series is padded with NaNs
assert np.isnan(tslearn_arr[1, 5:, 0]).all(), "Expected NaNs for padding in the shorter series"

# Verify that the original values are preserved
assert np.allclose(tslearn_arr[0, :10, 0], X[0, :10, 0]), "Values of the first series do not match"
assert np.allclose(tslearn_arr[1, :5, 0], X[1, :5, 0]), "Values of the second series do not match"

print(f"__CHECK__ from_seglearn_dataset {tslearn_arr.shape}")
